scenes.vo: Có người cuộn một tờ thẻ Pokémon chưa cắt, nhét lên gác mái, rồi bỏ quên nó lâu hơn tuổi đời của nhiều người đang xem video này.
scenes.gloss: Someone rolled up an uncut sheet of Pokémon cards, shoved it into the loft, and forgot it for longer than many of you watching have been alive.
scenes.viewer: A sheet of cards goes up into the loft and the hatch slams on it.

out.note: push into the shut hatch seam, dissolve to the loft above

scenes.build: new: the landing, the hatch with its hinged door and pull cord, the stepladder; the tube (pristine sheet rolled) with a rubber band.
scenes.blocking: The relative (red vest) on the stepladder at [0, -0.92], feet on the top step y 0.7, front view, head just under the open hatch.
scenes.action: f0-40 tube at his chest; f40-54 he stretches the rubber band over it; f55 SNAP (band on 'cắt'). f58-66 lifts it overhead, f67 shoves it up through the hatch ('nhét'): it flies 25 cm up and drops out of sight onto the boards; roll f70-96 heard, a clank on the fan f97. f100-108 he reaches up for the pull cord and yanks it; the door tips past vertical and falls shut f108-122 (gravity, accelerating), SLAM f122 ('quên'): dust sifts down from the seams onto his cap, he squeezes his eyes and coughs f126-150. f130-206 the camera rises past him to the shut hatch.

cams.why: low on the ladder, the hatch above

scenes.physics: tube toss: launched up at 2.2 m/s at f67, lands on the boards (unseen). Door: hinged at x -0.42, falls from 95 deg with gravity (angular, I = m L^2/3), slam f122, one 3 deg rebound. Dust: 40 motes fall from the seams, drift, settle by f190.
scenes.light_mood: golden 1999, warm bulb on the landing; a cold grey square of loft light in the open hatch until it shuts.
scenes.sound: rubber band twang f55; whoosh f66; thud + roll f70-96; fan clank f97; cord creak f104; SLAM f122 + Instagram Thud meme; cough f128.
scenes.after: The hatch is shut; dust settles on the landing carpet.

scenes.vo: Hai mươi bảy năm.
scenes.gloss: Twenty-seven years.
scenes.build: new: the loft with the tube against the lights box, the fan, the post with the calendar, the scissors, the empty frame.
scenes.blocking: nobody.
scenes.action: Locked frame. The calendar's pages flip on their own from 1999 to 2026 (f212-250, a page every 1.4 f, pages fluttering off and gone); the dust layer on the tube and the boards greys over. Title 1999 - 2026 f212.
scenes.physics: none.
scenes.light_mood: cold grey day from the gable window, a dusty light shaft.
scenes.sound: calendar flutter rising; a clock tick sped up.

scenes.vo: Nó sống chung với bụi, với nhện, và với cái quạt hỏng mà không ai dám vứt.
scenes.gloss: It lived with the dust, the spiders, and a broken fan nobody dares throw away.
scenes.viewer: Dust, a spider, the fan nobody dares touch.
scenes.build: the same frame; the hatch door opens and shuts for three heads.
scenes.blocking: Three heads pop up through the hatch at [0, -1.05] (feet y 1.25 on the ladder): f344-354 man in a cap, f356-366 teen with headphones, f368-380 woman with a bun.
scenes.action: f285-300 a dust puff drifts across the tube ('bụi'); f305-330 a spider drops on its thread from the rafter to just above the tube ('nhện' f311) and hangs, swaying; f339-343 the fan's loose blade creaks and swings ('quạt hỏng'). Each head: the door swings up 8 f, the head rises, eyes the fan, the blade twitches, the head ducks back down and the door drops (f344-380, 'không ai dám vứt').
scenes.acting: heads: nervous, eyes on the fan.
scenes.physics: the loose blade: a pendulum on its hub pin (swing 18 deg, damped).
scenes.sound: dust whisper; spider zip f305; fan creak f340; three door clunks; Suspicious Sound meme f356.

scenes.vo: Không ai cắt. Không ai đóng khung. Không ai nhớ nó tồn tại.
scenes.gloss: Nobody cut it. Nobody framed it. Nobody remembered it existed.
scenes.build: the scissors (rusty, open, on the nail), the empty frame, the cobweb over the tube.
scenes.blocking: nobody.

scenes.physics: none.
scenes.sound: three soft low notes, one per 'không ai'.

scenes.vo: Rồi nhà dọn kho.

scenes.sound: thump f526, door bang f533, dust puff, torch click f536.

scenes.gloss: Luckily the owner noticed the whole world going mad for Pokémon cards, so she hugged it and took it to ask,

scenes.sound: shop chatter, a till ding f1300, whistle.

scenes.vo: Và đây không phải giấy dán tường. Đây là tờ thẻ hologram bộ Fossil,
scenes.gloss: And this isn't wallpaper. This is a holographic Fossil card sheet,
scenes.viewer: Flattened under the lamp, the holos shine.

out.note: dive into the Gengar, dissolve to the same card on the fresh sheet

scenes.sound: unroll rasp, lamp click f1420, shimmer + Wowww meme f1498.
